H0942.name: Bavvai
H0942.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0942.brief: A leader who helped repair Jerusalem's wall
H0942.short: Bavvai, son of Henadad and ruler of half the district of Keilah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H0911.name: Bedad
H0911.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0911.brief: Father of Hadad, an Edomite king.
H0911.short: Bedad was the father of Hadad, one of the kings of Edom before Israel had a king.

H0917G.name: Bedan
H0917G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0917G.brief: A descendant of Manasseh through Machir and Gilead.
H0917G.short: Bedan was a descendant of Manasseh, listed in the genealogy of Machir and Gilead.

H0912.name: Bedeiah
H0912.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0912.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile.
H0912.short: Bedeiah was one of the Israelites who had married foreign women during the exile and agreed to send them away.

H0920.name: Bidkar
H0920.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0920.brief: Officer of Jehu who witnessed Ahab's judgment
H0920.short: Bidkar, an officer of Jehu, witnessed the LORD's judgment against Ahab and his family.

H0903.name: Bigtha
H0903.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0903.short: Bigtha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

H0904.name: Bigthan
H0904.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0904.brief: Persian official who plotted against King Ahasuerus
H0904.short: Bigthan, a doorkeeper in Ahasuerus' court, plotted to assassinate the king but was exposed by Mordecai.

H0902H.name: Bigvai
H0902H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0902H.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
H0902H.short: Bigvai was an ancestor of over 2,000 individuals who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H0902G.name: Bigvai
H0902G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0902G.brief: Leader who returned from Babylonian exile
H0902G.short: Bigvai was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H0902I.name: Bigvai
H0902I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0902I.brief: Judahite leader who sealed the covenant
H0902I.short: Bigvai, a leader of the people, sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H0968.name: Biztha
H0968.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0968.short: Biztha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

H0932.name: Bohan
H0932.brief: Reubenite after whom a boundary stone was named
H0932.short: Bohan, son of Reuben, was the namesake of a boundary stone between the territories of Judah and Benjamin.

H0946.name: Bunah
H0946.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0946.brief: Son of Jerahmeel, descendant of Judah
H0946.short: Bunah was a son of Jerahmeel and a descendant of Judah.

H0938H.name: Buz
H0938H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0938H.brief: Descendant of Gad, son of Abdiel
H0938H.short: Buz, a descendant of Gad, was the son of Abdiel and the father of Jahdo.

H0938G.name: Buz
H0938G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0938G.short: Buz was the son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and the father of the Buzites.

H0941.name: Buzi
H0941.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0941.short: Buzi, a priest, was the father of Ezekiel the prophet.

H0940.name: Buzites
H0940.short: The Buzites were descendants of Buz, the son of Nahor, Abraham's brother.

H0980.name: Bahurim
H0980.brief: Village near Jerusalem, home of Shimei, who cursed David.
H0980.short: Bahurim (or Baharum) was a village near Jerusalem, known as the home of Shimei, who cursed David. (<ref="2Sa.3.16; 16:5; 17:18; 19:16; 1Ki.2.8; 2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33">2Sa.3.16; 16:5; 17:18; 19:16; 1Ki.2.8; 2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33</ref>)

forms.meaning: “son of the blackened: in the pitied”

H0984.name: Betah
H0984.brief: City from which David took bronze after defeating Hadadezer.
H0984.short: Betah was a city from which David took a large amount of bronze after defeating Hadadezer, king of Zobah. (<ref="2Sa.8.8">2Sa.8.8</ref>)

H0991.name: Beten
H0991.brief: Town allotted to the tribe of Asher.
H0991.short: Beten was a town allotted to the tribe of Asher in the division of the Promised Land. (<ref="Joshua 19:25">Joshua 19:25</ref>)

H0993.name: Betonim
H0993.short: Betonim was a town allotted to the tribe of Gad in the region of Gilead.

H0966H.name: Bezek
H0966H.short: Bezek was the place where Saul assembled the Israelite army to fight against the Ammonites.

H0966G.name: Bezek
H0966G.short: Bezek was a city where the tribe of Judah defeated the Canaanites and Perizzites.

H0964.name: Biziothiah
H0964.brief: A town in the Negev, allotted to Judah
H0964.short: Biziothiah, a town in the Negev region, was allotted to the tribe of Judah.

H0949.name: Bozez
H0949.short: Bozez, one of the rocky crags that Jonathan and his armor-bearer crossed to attack the Philistine garrison.

H0938I.name: Buz
H0938I.brief: Arabian tribe, possibly descendants of Nahor
H0938I.short: Buz was an Arabian tribe, possibly descended from Nahor, that was threatened with judgment.

H0930.name: Behemoth
H0930.brief: A powerful, majestic creature described in the Bible
H0930.short: Behemoth, mentioned in <ref="Job.40.15">Job.40.15</ref>, is a powerful and majestic creature that God uses to illustrate His creative power and sovereignty.

H0945.name: Bul
H0945.brief: The eighth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar
H0945.short: Bul, mentioned in <ref="1Ki.6.38">1Ki.6.38</ref>, is the eighth month in the ancient Hebrew calendar, corresponding to October-November in the modern calendar.
